internal process(): conditionally pokes all 21 OSM contracts via pass()/poke() and then pokes 23 Spotter ilks.
external poke(): calls process(), then pokes univ2wbtcdai/univ2aaveeth OSMs and their Spotter ilks; permissionless entrypoint.
external pokeTemp(): calls process(); permissionless entrypoint used for OSMs before collateral is added.
msg.sender of the external calls to poke()/pokeTemp(); unauthenticated caller, no owner or modifier checks.
Batch of untrusted external OsmLike calls (pass() guard then poke()) on 21 OSM contracts inside process(); executed without reentrancy guard.
Untrusted external SpotLike.poke(bytes32) calls on the Spotter contract with hardcoded ilk identifiers.
Untrusted external calls on univ2wbtcdai/univ2aaveeth OSMs and their Spotter ilks executed inside poke() after process().

process() drives the batch of external OSM pass()/poke() calls.
process() drives the batch of external spot.poke(ilk) calls.
poke() invokes the internal process() before its own additional pokes.
pokeTemp() invokes the internal process() only.
poke() is external with no owner or access modifier, so any msg.sender can trigger the OSM/Spotter updates.
pokeTemp() is external and permissionless, so any msg.sender can trigger the OSM updates.
Untrusted external OSM pass()/poke() calls can callback into the permissionless poke() entrypoint with no reentrancy guard.
